formula: Hazard = (0.4*SlopeRisk + 0.3*RoughnessRisk) / 0.7  [full model: 0.4*SlopeRisk + 0.3*RoughnessRisk + 0.2*Obstacle + 0.1*Crater; renormalised over the available weight]
disclaimer: Prototype hazard index for route-planning demonstrations only. It is derived from orbital topography with heuristic weights and has not been validated against rover traversability data. It is not a mission-planning product.

factor_sources.slope: HiRISE DTM 1 m (USGS), slope on the 5 m mean surface
factor_sources.roughness: HiRISE DTM 1 m (USGS), RMS residual about the 9 x 9 m moving mean
